SQL_DOC.P_SQL: UPDATE ERPDB.KEPRE SET IFFLAG = '3' , TPRICE = CAST($T_PRICE$ AS DECIMAL(17,5)) , IFDATE = CAST($IFDATE$ AS CHARACTER(8)), IFTIME= CAST($IFTIME$ AS CHARACTER(6)) WHERE PLANT = CAST($PLANT$ AS CHARACTER(10)) AND RENO = CAST($RE_NO$ AS CHARACTER(20)) AND RESEQ = CAST($RE_SEQ$ AS CHARACTER(10)) AND RSTG = CAST($AGENT_CODE$ AS CHARACTER(10)) AND IFFLAG IN ('1','3')
